name: Erin
source:
Erin runs a small inn in the village together with her sister, Mary.

She is a positive, welcoming character, who takes an interest in Lena right away and accepted her with open arms, unlike most of the villagers. Her dream is to turn their small inn into a great restaurant – something quite unlikely in the tiny little mountain village where they live.

Easily impressed by Lena’s knightly background, Erin is a bit of a dreamer. She loves cooking and socializing with others, but stays somewhat isolated in spite of this.

[from [url=http://hinoyabu.wordpress.com/2012/04/26/blue-rose-characters-erin/]Creator's blog[/url]]
